newsitem.title: FRANCE: Toulouse-Blagnac air cargo traffic down 8pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Toulouse-Blagnac air cargo traffic down 8pct in 96.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at Toulouse-Blagnac declined eight percent to 25,503 tonnes in 1996 compared to 1995, provisional figures from the airport authority figures showed.

While freight declined over the year as a whole, there was a significant recovery in November and December, up 12 and seven percent respectively on 1995 levels, largely due to greater use of belly capacity on passenger services from Toulouse," an airport authority official told Reuters.
United Parcel Service, operates a weekday feeder flight between Lyon-Satolas and Toulouse with a two-tonne cargo capacity Beechcraft 1900 chartered from French airline Air Littoral.
DHL Worldwide Express also operates a nightly flight between Brussels and Toulouse using a six-tonne capacity Convair aircraft.
Toulouse also features on French express distributor, Jet Services' domestic airfreight network which operates BAe146 QC (quick change) aircraft.
Airfreight is also carried by airlines operating passenger services to and from Toulouse, notably the Air France group.
The airport is also served by airline trucking services.
Postal traffic increased by eight percent on the previous year to 19,574 tonnes.
French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle hub and Toulouse using Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
